guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice has the largest latency shift (p50 +2017%, z=+403) and memory grew from 4.49e7 to 2.02e8 (+349%, z=+69.8), while upstream frontend, checkoutservice and recommendationservice latencies rise in line with it. The slowest traces all pass through currencyservice with no error spans and no warning or error logs, so the mem fault is inferred from metrics alone; the socket increase (3 to ~6) and the small CPU rise (+30%) are weaker signals that could point to other fault types.

proposed_fix.description: Restart or roll currencyservice pods to release memory, then inspect for a memory leak and set or raise memory limits. Treat this as a mitigation until the leak is confirmed.
